description.value: Doner Kebab is a fast-food spot on West 4th Avenue in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, a popular cycling corridor connecting downtown to UBC. It serves doner kebab, a Turkish-style dish of seasoned rotisserie meat sliced into flatbread or wraps — a filling, portable option for cyclists passing through. The business was field-verified in OSM as recently as August 2024.
